name: Cognitive Maze v1.2.5 - High-Speed Camera Tracking & Responsiveness Release
notes: Version 1.2.5 — Changes: 1.4x ergonomic camera cursor gain (center-sweetspot bounds 0.25-0.75 x, 0.24-0.76 y) for effortless mouse-like full-screen reach; retuned OneEuroFilter (min_cutoff=1.15, beta=0.075) and high-gain 60 FPS inter-frame interpolation (38-60 lerp) for near-zero hand tracking latency; smooth 2D exploration walk speed ramp (1.0x to 1.35x across 45-105px) across Tutorial, Stage Select, and Quarters 1-4. Fixes: Eliminated triple-stacked smoothing lag and per-display-frame micro-deadband drag that choked gentle hand glides; fixed Windows DirectShow UVC property initialization order so webcams lock at 30 FPS MJPG (320x240) instead of resetting to 15 FPS YUY2; anchored fist clicks to pre-curl cursor coordinates for 0.00px click slip.
